card.name: Words before strong CYP3A inhibitors
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'strong' or 'with' right after 'avoid ... with' and before CYP3A inhibitor terms in drug interaction text. Also scattered single words in general prose such as 'one', 'beginning', 'of'.

modes.label: Before CYP3A inhibitors
modes.description: A linking word such as 'with' or 'strong' just before the name of a CYP3A inhibitor class.
modes.example: Avoid concurrent use of IBRANCE with<< strong>> CYP3A inhibitors.

modes.label: Scattered prose words
modes.description: Common words in religious or historical prose, mid-sentence, with no shared theme.
modes.example: He was in the<< beginning>> with God; all things were made through
